question: In Cricket, what is the distance between two wickets?
solution:
The correct answer is __**22 yards.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **distance between two wickets** in cricket is** 22 yards **or **20.12 meters.**
 
• The distance is measured from the** center of both the wickets.**
 
• The two wickets are placed at a** distance of 1.22 meters** or **4 feet** and **1 inch **from each other.
 
• The wickets are made of **three wooden stumps** with** two wooden bails **placed on top of them.
 
• Option 2, 3, and 4 are** incorrect** as the distance between two wickets is 22 yards and not any of the other options mentioned.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cricket **is a **popular sport **played across the world.
 
• The game is played between **two teams**, each consisting of **11 players.**
 
• The objective of the game is to score as many runs as possible while also dismissing the opposition team's batsmen.
 
• The game is played on a** circular or oval-shaped field** with a rectangular 22-yard-long pitch in the center.
